item.title: Journal Prompts for Connection: 3 Gentle Questions
item.description: Three journal prompts for connection, inspired by Japanese ideas like kizuki (気づき), the moment of noticing. Who have I been thinking about lately? Whose kindness do I still remember? Who could I reach out to this week? Write a few lines for each, or simply sit with one. From GLOBAL INNER DIVINE, a small studio in Japan.

item.title: Printable New Year Reflection Journal: 7 Quiet Days from the Winter Solstice, Inspired by Japan
item.description: A printable New Year reflection journal for the last days of December. The Winter Circle follows seven Japanese customs, from the winter solstice to the first writing of the year. Each day has a short explanation, a classic haiku with our own translation, one small practice, and three journal prompts. A USD 5 PDF to print or fill in on a tablet. From GLOBAL INNER DIVINE, a small studio in Japan.
